guidance.statement: Damas will be consolidated into financials from Q4 onwards
guidance.quote: consolidation of Damas books into Titan consolidation will start from 1st January

guidance.statement: CaratLane to maintain low double-digit EBIT margin profile
guidance.quote: they would stay there, low double-digit margin EBIT profile

guidance.statement: International margins will gradually improve toward India jewellery margin levels
guidance.quote: gradually, it will improve, will reflect jewellery margin, which we have in India

guidance.statement: Margins will face continued pressure if gold prices remain elevated
guidance.quote: In continuously rising gold prices, jewellery margins will kind of exhibit pressure

delivered.statement: Jewellery division delivered 40% revenue growth in Q3 FY26
Average transaction value reached 1.9 lakhs in Q3, highest recorded ever
New buyers contributed 45% of Q3 sales, up from 42% in Q2
Over 50% of jewellery business now includes an exchange element
Jewellery purchase plans account for 20-25% of total business
Eyecare domestic growth of 17.5% with 9% volume growth in Q3
Completed 67% stake acquisition of Damas during Q3 FY26
Labour code impact: INR 152 crores consolidated, INR 138 crores standalone

themes: Gold price volatility driving consumer FOMO and accelerating purchase behavior
Product innovation: 14-carat, 18-carat, and 9-carat jewellery introduced across brands
Exchange programs and repeat customer loyalty via Encircle and Tata Neu
Operating leverage offsetting margin pressure from product mix and gold inflation
International consolidation of TEAL, CaratLane, and Damas into complex portfolio
Sub-1 lakh segment affordability pressure; targeting recovery via new campaigns
risks: Jewellery margins under pressure if gold price elevation continues; EBIT growth prioritized over margin %
Sub-1 lakh studded segment faces affordability pressure amid persistent 70-80% gold price inflation
International operations (Damas, TEAL) unprofitable with margin volatility from project-based business model
Consumer shift to lower carats and lightweight jewellery structurally compresses margin profile

analyst_pushback.pushback: Analyst pressed on 200 bps margin decline; management responded: business mix and studded margin impact from gold, not promotional discounting

analyst_pushback.topic: Flat buyer growth with 45% new contribution
analyst_pushback.pushback: Contradiction noted; management: existing customers driving repeat purchases via loyalty programs; new buyers stable QoQ
Analyst claimed 75% business immune; management pushback: upsell has gold impact, no one truly immune to price increases
Why studded growing slower? Management: gold ticket size up 44% vs studded 15% because gold content increases, not volume weakness

tone_evidence: Confident on execution and quarter (great demand, good teams), cautious on Q4 (won't give guidance due to volatility), defensive on margins
